 Familiarity with MCP, including exposing public MCP servers and tools.
 Experience designing telemetry for AI systems, and using it to make engineering and product decisions.

 POSITION SUMMARY  
 The Indigenous Patient Navigator (IPN) supports First Nations, Inuit, and Métis and Urban Indigenous patients and families to access equitable, safe, timely, and culturally responsive care across CHEO and the broader health system. Working in partnership with Indigenous patients, families, clinical teams, and community partners, The IPN facilitates navigation, advocacy, and care coordination while centering Indigenous world views, rights, and self-determination. 
 The IPN promotes the inclusion of patient and family voice in clinical decision making and supports patients and families in understanding care pathways, care plans, and follow-up. The IPN facilitates access to cultural, spiritual, emotional, and practical supports, assists with care coordination, and connects patients and families to appropriate community partners. The IPN addresses systemic barriers, responds to and supports the prevention of racism and discrimination in health care settings, and contributes to improved patient experience and health outcomes. 
 MAIN RESPONSABILITIES   
 Patient Navigation & Advocacy – 40%  
 Provide trauma informed, culturally safe navigation for Indigenous patients and families across primary, acute, specialty, and community services. 
 Support informed consent processes, care planning, appointment scheduling, referrals, discharge coordination, and follow up, including transportation and medical escort needs, where applicable. 
 Advocate for patient rights by identifying and addressing barriers (e.g., jurisdictional issues, coverage or beneﬁts, language needs, or documentation requirements) and escalating concerns related to discrimination or unsafe care. 
 Support patient and family understanding by offering explanations of diagnoses treatments options, medications, and care pathways. facilitate shared decision making throughout the patient’s care journey. 
 Participate in case management discussions or Safety Incident Report debriefs, as required. 
 Cultural Safety & Antiracism – 20%  
 Promote cultural safety practices and challenge discriminatory behaviors and policies within care environments through respectful, collaborative, and solution focused engagement. Contribute to antiracism and quality improvement initiatives. 
 Facilitate access to traditional medicines, Elders or Knowledge Keepers, ceremony (e.g., smudging), and land-based supports in alignment with patient preference and organizational policy. 
 Connect staff, medical staff, learners and volunteers to educational opportunities on Indigenous health contexts, colonial impacts, and determinants of health. 
 Contribute in partnership with Indigeneity, Inclusion, Diversity, Equity, Access, and Social Justice (I-IDEAS) to the development of educational and training resources supporting staff, medical staff, learners and volunteers on Indigenous Safer Care. 
 Documentation, Data, and Privacy – 10%  
 Document navigation activities in appropriate systems in compliance with privacy legislation and in support of Indigenous data sovereignty principles (e.g. distinction-based considerations). 
 Utilize secure, trauma informed approaches to the collection, storage, and sharing patient information, obtaining consent for the involvement of any community or external supports. 
 Contribute to program metrics (e.g., access, wait times, patient experience, cultural safety indicators) and quality improvement reporting. 
 Program & Organizational Contributions – 10%  
 Participate in case conferences, huddles, and rounds, bringing forward patient and family voice and cultural safety considerations. 
 Contribute to developing resources on available supports for medical staff beneﬁting Indigenous patients and families. 
 QUALIFICATIONS   
 Bachelor’s degree in Nursing, Social Work or a related Indigenous Health ﬁeld* (Essential)

 Knowledge of Indigenous histories, cultures, languages, holistic wellness models, colonial impacts, intergenerational trauma, social determinants of health, community engagement, and cultural protocols (Essential)

 Strong organizational and time management skills to balance competing demands and priorities. 
 Commitment to excellence, patient focused care, and the consistent exercise of diplomacy and tact (Essential)

Analytics is a central function that exists to drive business outcomes across Jobber’s ecosystem.



The Role

Jobber is looking for a Manager, Customer Analytics (Sales & Marketing) to lead the analytics function supporting our Marketing & Channels and Sales & Partnerships pods. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Customer Analytics, this leader will manage a team of analysts and partner closely with Directors, Senior Directors, and VPs across Demand Generation, Brand Marketing & Communications, Sales, Partnerships, MarketingOps, SalesOps, and Finance.

You will own the measurement infrastructure that helps Jobber connect acquisition investment to subscription revenue growth, understand marketing effectiveness, evaluate channel and partnership performance, and improve visibility into CAC, LTV, payback, sales efficiency, revenue funnel performance, and go-to-market ROI.

This role requires a leader who combines strong people leadership, hands-on technical depth, and deep Sales and Marketing domain expertise. You will build trusted relationships with senior leaders, raise the bar for analytical quality, and develop analysts who can translate rigorous measurement into better growth decisions.

You will also help Jobber advance Analytics 2.0 in practice by using self-serve analytics, automation, responsible AI, and agentic workflows to scale trusted decision support and create more capacity for strategic, high-judgment analytical work.

Team Leadership & Analytics Operating Model

Performance Marketing, Demand Generation & Channel Measurement

 Position Overview
 The Treasury and Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day treasury, digital asset custody, liquidity, reconciliation, and operational control activities supporting the firm’s crypto asset business.
 This role will manage the movement, safeguarding, and reconciliation of client and operational assets across multiple custodians, wallet infrastructure providers, and trading venues. The Treasury and Operations Manager will work closely with Compliance, Risk, Finance, Trading, Technology, and Operations to ensure client assets are handled securely, accurately, and in accordance with internal controls and applicable regulatory requirements.
 The successful candidate will bring strong operational discipline, attention to detail, and an understanding of digital asset infrastructure, treasury controls, and regulated financial services operations.
 Key Responsibilities
 Digital Asset Wallet Operations & Custody Administration
 Administer digital asset wallets and custody infrastructure across platforms including Fireblocks, Coinbase, BitGo, and other approved custodians or service providers.
 Manage client deposit wallets, operational vault accounts, and related wallet structures in accordance with established custody and segregation requirements.
 Execute and oversee wallet whitelisting, transaction approvals, wallet policy configuration, and authorized address management.
 Conduct periodic user access and entitlement reviews to ensure appropriate segregation of duties and adherence to internal access-control standards.
 Maintain accurate records of wallet configurations, approvals, authorized personnel, and custody-related changes.
 Deposit Sweeps & Fund Flows
 Oversee the timely sweep of client digital asset deposits from designated deposit wallets into operational or custody vault accounts.
 Ensure incoming funds are accurately attributed to the appropriate client accounts and reflected in internal systems and sub-ledgers.
 Monitor sweep thresholds, transaction limits, and approval workflows to ensure transfers comply with established treasury controls.
 Investigate delayed, failed, or incorrectly attributed transactions and coordinate resolution with relevant internal teams and external vendors.
 Monitor end-to-end fund flows to identify operational bottlenecks, control weaknesses, or settlement risks.
 Reconciliation
 Perform and oversee daily reconciliation of:
 On-chain wallet balances;
 Custodian account records;
 Internal operational and accounting ledgers;
 Client sub-ledgers; and
 Trading and settlement records.
 Investigate reconciliation breaks promptly and coordinate corrective actions with Finance, Operations, Technology, and external counterparties.
 Escalate unreconciled or aged items in accordance with defined service-level agreements and escalation procedures.
 Maintain complete reconciliation records and supporting evidence for audit and regulatory review.
 Identify recurring reconciliation issues and implement process or system improvements to reduce operational risk.
 Liquidity & Treasury Management
 Monitor operational, settlement, and client withdrawal liquidity across custodians, trading venues, and approved digital asset infrastructure providers.
 Forecast short- and medium-term funding requirements based on trading activity, client deposits and withdrawals, settlement obligations, and operational needs.
 Execute liquidity rebalancing between approved custodians, wallets, and trading venues in accordance with established limits and approval authorities.
 Maintain minimum liquidity buffers and other treasury thresholds to support uninterrupted trading and client withdrawal obligations.
 Monitor concentration and counterparty exposure associated with operational asset balances.
 Escalate potential liquidity shortfalls or settlement risks to senior management, Risk, and Finance.
 Staking Operations
 Support the operational administration of approved digital asset staking activities through providers such as BitGo, Figment, or other approved platforms.
 Coordinate asset delegation, staking instructions, unstaking activity, and related operational processes.
 Track staking rewards, validator activity, fees, and expected settlement timelines.
 Reconcile staking rewards and yield against custodian records, internal ledgers, and the general ledger.
 Work with Finance and Compliance to ensure appropriate accounting, reporting, and recordkeeping for staking activity.
 Compliance & Financial Crime Escalations
 Serve as the primary treasury and operational point of contact for transaction-related compliance escalations.
 Review and coordinate responses to Know Your Transaction (KYT) alerts generated through platforms such as Chainalysis.
 Support investigation and resolution of Travel Rule exceptions through platforms such as Notabene.
 Coordinate treasury actions arising from fraud alerts or investigations managed through platforms such as Unit21.
 Work closely with Compliance to execute approved transaction holds, wallet restrictions, freezes, releases, or other remediation actions.

 Escalate unusual, high-risk, or time-sensitive matters in accordance with established procedures.
 Regulatory, Audit & Examination Support

 Support external financial statement audits, internal audits, SOC examinations, regulatory reviews, and other assurance activities.
 Provide documentation supporting client asset segregation, custody arrangements, wallet balances, transaction activity, and control effectiveness.

 Respond to audit and regulatory information requests in a timely, accurate, and organized manner.
 Assist with remediation of treasury-related findings and track corrective actions through completion.
 Treasury Controls, Procedures & Governance
 Own and maintain treasury-related standard operating procedures, workflows, approval matrices, and control documentation.
 Establish and continuously improve controls over wallet access, transaction approvals, liquidity transfers, reconciliation, and client asset movements.
 Ensure appropriate maker-checker controls and segregation of duties are maintained for sensitive treasury activities.
 Partner with Risk, Compliance, Finance, Technology, and Internal Audit to identify and mitigate treasury and operational risks.
 Participate in control testing, risk assessments, incident reviews, and remediation initiatives.
 Monitor adherence to treasury policies and escalate control exceptions or breaches appropriately.
 Identify opportunities to automate manual treasury processes while maintaining appropriate oversight and control.
 Vendor & Counterparty Management
 Act as the primary operational relationship contact for treasury and digital asset infrastructure providers, including Fireblocks, Coinbase, BitGo, Chainalysis, Notabene, Unit21, and other approved vendors.
 Coordinate operational service reviews, issue escalation, incident management, and vendor support.

 Maintain current documentation relating to operational contacts, escalation pathways, system dependencies, and service procedures.
 Treasury Reporting & Management Information

 Client and operational asset balances;
 Custodian and wallet balances;
 Deposit and withdrawal activity;
 Liquidity positions and buffer levels;
 Outstanding settlement obligations;
 Reconciliation breaks and aged exceptions;
 Staking balances and rewards;
 Significant treasury or operational incidents; and
 Key risk and control indicators.
 Provide timely reporting and analysis to Finance, Risk, Compliance, Operations, and senior management.

 Operational Leadership & Cross-Functional Support

 Partner with Technology and Product teams on the implementation and testing of new digital asset products, custody capabilities, and operational workflows.
